integrity.external_theorem: Stong beat-point deletion theorem; finite compact-open pointwise specialization order as described by May and Pishevar.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact finite combinatorial enumeration and a complete independently replayable beat-point witness sequence, plus the standard finite-space deformation-retract theorem.
integrity.publication_status: No authorship, peer review, or independent certification asserted.

scientific_limitations: The certified homotopy type is for the fixed sixteen-point product torus and four-point target, not for arbitrary finite tori or subdivisions.
The strong deformation retraction is verified by an exhaustive 2824-step beat-point certificate; it has no parameter-uniform generalization here.
The nine connected components and the 2836-map count were previously obtained; only the stronger mapping-space core and integral first homology are claimed as additional.
An unindexed earlier equivalent computation cannot be ruled out by search alone.
title: The finite torus-to-circle function space retracts onto a circle and eight points
